hypothesis: At least one of three new risk-asset/safe-asset ratios—QQQ/TLT, XBI/XLV, or IYT/IEF—can use event-only completion of the existing V11 positive target weights to 100% gross more selectively than its own matched unconditional completion control, increasing return without leverage while preserving controlled drawdown and risk-adjusted performance.
allowed_changes: F-GROWTHBOND exact QQQ/TLT adjusted-close 20-common-observation relative-strength state from the frozen design
F-BIOTECH exact XBI/XLV adjusted-close 20-common-observation relative-strength state from the frozen design
F-TRANSPORT exact IYT/IEF adjusted-close 20-common-observation relative-strength state from the frozen design
event-only completion of current positive V11 holdings to exactly 100% gross when factor state is risk-on
forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
any lookback, stale tolerance, gross target, threshold, percentile, z-score, moving-average, persistence or band search
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
combining F-GROWTHBOND, F-BIOTECH and F-TRANSPORT inside this trial
replacing a failed candidate after results are viewed
adding a fourth factor inside this trial
leverage, financing, shorting or negative cash
using realized candidate metrics to modify another candidate
changing the 100% gross completion target to another percentage after results
selection_metric: No winner optimization. Compare each factor against V11-CONTROL and its own matched availability ALWAYS-complete control, then mechanically report ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS and STRONG_INCREMENTAL flags.
pass_fail_gates: full-history Sharpe > the factor's own matched availability control Sharpe
at least 4/7 fixed folds have candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe in the same fold
max gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
STRONG_INCREMENTAL only if admitted plus CAGR >= V11 CAGR +1.0 percentage point and Sharpe >= V11 Sharpe
follow_up_policy: No rescue search is allowed after results. Do not change the 20-observation horizon, 7-day stale rule, 25% replay band, 100% gross completion target, factor direction or event-only architecture. Any different transform, target, factor combination or new factor is a separately preregistered family and all three results remain in G3 trial accounting.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_orthogonal_event_budget_v5.py -> tools/orthogonal_event_budget_v5.swiftpart + immutable tools/orthogonal_event_factor_v3_logic.swift + immutable tools/orthogonal_factor_family_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: all seven fixed fold metrics for every path
trade count and average cash ratio
source event count, underinvested event count, factor-available underinvested events and completed events
target fingerprint, max gross and min target weight
run authorization receipt, exact execution Git commit and SHA-256 evidence manifests

F-GROWTHBOND.risk_on_rule: latest usable QQQ/TLT ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
F-GROWTHBOND.matched_control: complete current V11 positive holdings to 100% gross on every factor-available underinvested V11 event

F-BIOTECH.risk_on_rule: latest usable XBI/XLV ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
F-BIOTECH.matched_control: complete current V11 positive holdings to 100% gross on every factor-available underinvested V11 event

F-TRANSPORT.risk_on_rule: latest usable IYT/IEF ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
F-TRANSPORT.matched_control: complete current V11 positive holdings to 100% gross on every factor-available underinvested V11 event

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty
